gaps.quote: So $q$ divides no numerator or denominator of the finitely many matrices used.
gaps.note: The page only requires that q not divide the denominators xi. It does not follow that q divides no numerator (zero entries have numerator 0), and the needed claim that the factor matrices F_1, F_2 and their inverses are invertible mod q is never justified.

Following the three stated operations gives D = eta+zeta, then after the swap H = eta+zeta and D = eta, then D = eta-(eta+zeta) = -zeta. So the pair becomes (eta+zeta, -zeta), not (eta+zeta, zeta); the reader cannot verify the claim.

gaps.quote: So the shear needs $2\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb Q}M$ interchanges plus $O(V)$ further work.
gaps.note: Each update uses one interchange and there are rank_Q M ones in Pi, so the page's own count gives rank_Q M interchanges, not 2 rank_Q M. The later per-wire claim of fewer than R interchanges also counts ranks, not twice ranks.
